question: Does frozen current-main Duskblade behaviour contain enough reproducible, inactive, viable, reachable and Scoreline-separated support for one source-defined producer-to-next-Attack one-bit setup grammar to justify implementing exactly one minimal Dusk-only payoff primitive for identity preflight?
competingOptions: freeze the first passing grammar in the preregistered simplicity order for disabled-factor identity preflight
close the complete one-bit producer-to-next-Attack grammar without implementation and continue with another evidence-backed structural family inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

scientificBasis.existingGrammarBoundary: Existing Resonant Lance, partial-Facet Faultline, Cracked tempo, generic Shatter flow, Crown, heavy-Attack relay, reseam break, Honing repeat, Ward, Kindle and Afterimage directions are closed by their immutable decisions. This inventory does not reconstruct or retest them.
scientificBasis.newPrimitiveAuthority: The current issue #421 body authorises the smallest new deterministic card, relic or effect primitive only after evidence shows existing grammar cannot express the missing complementarity.
scientificBasis.cheapestDiscriminatingEvidence: Reuse the 256 explicit-current whole-run traces that already reproduced the frozen cached baseline path, RNG and result exactly. No simulator or ledger row is needed to measure source-card reachability and exact same-fight action order.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: This is a necessary capacity screen. A pass supports only one research-factor implementation and focused identity/mediator proof; it is not causal payoff evidence, product content, package admission or detector calibration.

sharedFuturePrimitive.state: One boolean setup bit, initially false. A registered producer sets it true; repeated producers do not stack. The next played Attack consumes it.
sharedFuturePrimitive.futurePayoff: At level 1, the consuming Attack chips exactly 1 additional Facet after the Attack resolves. Level 0 changes nothing.
sharedFuturePrimitive.nonEffects: No damage, Energy, Ward, draw, healing, status, offer, rarity, acquisition, policy score or RNG call changes. The eventual research factor must be disabled by default and cannot ship as a global aspect rule.
sharedFuturePrimitive.carrierBoundary: This inventory selects a mechanism predicate, not a shipping carrier. A deterministic reward/economy carrier is chosen and validated only after causal and held-out package evidence, never to rescue a failed grammar.

candidates.producerDefinition: Any card in the frozen natural reward pools whose authored type is power.
candidates.mechanisticJustification: A Power is a deliberate long-horizon form commitment. Arming one subsequent Attack converts that existing strategic commitment into bounded Dusk facet pressure without repeating a named-card handshake.

candidates.producerDefinition: Any card in the frozen natural reward pools with a direct positive authored energy effect.
candidates.mechanisticJustification: A deliberate Energy-producing action can prime one later Attack, testing an action-economy setup route without the closed Shatter-to-heavy-Attack discount or a zero-cost threshold.

candidates.producerDefinition: Any Skill in the frozen natural reward pools with a direct positive authored draw effect.
candidates.mechanisticJustification: A reward-pool cycling Skill followed by an Attack expresses setup-through-hand-shaping. Excluding starter First Spark prevents universal starter ownership from defining the route.

selectionJustification: The order is frozen by runtime predicate simplicity before counts: one native card-type test, then one direct effect-kind test, then a card-type plus effect-kind test. The first complete pass is selected without ranking effect magnitude or inspecting outcomes for tie-breaking.
closedDirections: existing Resonant Lance and Shatter-echo packages
generic Shatter flow, Crown threshold, heavy-Attack relay and reseam break
Honing Edge same-instance repeat and every policy preference remap
Ward, Kindle, Afterimage and tested issue #524/#525 paths
named-card package-order, acquisition commitment and V39-style adaptive tuning

fixedCausalFactors.sharedFuturePayoff: Unimplemented and fixed at level 0 in all evidence rows.
fixedCausalFactors.scorelinePayoff: A separate causal factor fixed by the exact baseline content and rules; never varied or estimated.
fixedCausalFactors.afterimagePayoff: A separate causal factor fixed independently by the exact baseline content and rules; never varied or estimated.
fixedCausalFactors.acquisitionPriority: Fixed at the exact current baseline path.
fixedCausalFactors.faultlineRarity: Fixed by the baseline content SHA.
fixedCausalFactors.wardSetupPriority: Fixed at its exact current/null path.
fixedCausalFactors.policyMapping: The closed Momentum remap is not used; only the exact current arm supplies trace evidence.

capacityDefinitions.activeRow: Within one fight, at least one registered producer play precedes a later Attack play.
capacityDefinitions.activePolicy: At least two of the four frozen rows are active rows.
capacityDefinitions.inactivePolicy: None of the four frozen rows is active.
capacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows is active.
capacityDefinitions.offeredPolicy: At least one frozen row naturally offers a registered producer.
capacityDefinitions.acquiredPolicy: At least one frozen row ends with a registered producer in the deck.
capacityDefinitions.viableActivePolicy: The policy is active and has at least one active Vow-5 row whose whole-run outcome is win.
capacityDefinitions.activatedProducerBreadth: Distinct registered producer card IDs that actually precede a later Attack in any frozen row.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineRouteRow: Within one fight, Chisel precedes a later Faultline play. This is a fixed route proxy, not a Scoreline payoff estimate.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are Scoreline-route rows.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Active for the candidate but not the Scoreline route.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineOnlyPolicy: Active for the Scoreline route but not the candidate.

interactionAndAlias.interactions: None. No factor varies and no causal interaction is estimated.
interactionAndAlias.candidateOverlap: Surge is deliberately present in both the energy and cycle source definitions because it has both direct authored effects. All three grammars are screened simultaneously, but at most one can be selected; overlap is reported through exact policy sets and never treated as independent evidence.
interactionAndAlias.scorelineInterference: Candidate-only, Scoreline-only and Jaccard gates are applied to the same frozen policy identities. No optional joint cell or Cartesian expansion exists.
interactionAndAlias.staging: This zero-row path/mediator screen may authorise focused identity proof. It supports no whole-run payoff endpoint because the payoff has not been implemented or comparably evaluated.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: After trace and row-label fields are removed, every current row must exactly equal its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result before any candidate count is read.

scorelineAnchor.source: The exact current-arm same-fight Chisel-before-Faultline policy set already frozen in the Momentum preference summary.

cohort.identity: The exact complete current-main first-look rectangle is reused for every candidate; no policy or seed is selected, replaced or extended.

estimands.unit: Policy identity with the frozen two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.primary: Exact active, inactive and ambiguous policy counts and identities for each candidate.
estimands.reachability: Exact natural offer and final-deck acquisition policy counts.
estimands.viability: Exact active policies with at least one active winning Vow-5 row.
estimands.sourceBreadth: Exact distinct producer card IDs observed in a qualifying sequence.
estimands.separation: Exact candidate-only, Scoreline-only, cross-active and Jaccard policy-set statistics.
estimands.notEstimated: No payoff, complementarity, interaction, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected-seed or product effect is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic source filtering, exact same-fight event ordering and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: All three preregistered source grammars are evaluated once from the same immutable trace. No candidate is added, removed, thresholded or rerun after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Select the first complete pass in the frozen simplicity order, close the family when none passes, or record inconclusive only at the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/16 inactive and eight reachability, viability and two-sided separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look support scale. Two producer cards prevents a one-card alias. The 0.75 Jaccard ceiling is unchanged, and one fault is the immutable cached baseline rather than a candidate addition.

decisionRules.success: The first candidate in the frozen simplicity order whose active, inactive, reachability, viability, source-breadth and two-sided Scoreline-separation gates all pass is frozen; later passing candidates are reported but receive no authority.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Implement only the selected Dusk-only binary payoff factor, disabled by default, plus one focused producer/consumer surface. Prove omitted/null path, RNG, policy and result identity and that level 1 changes only the intended one-bit mediator and one-Facet consumer payoff before preregistering any equal-cohort CRN row. Do not choose a shipping carrier, add a level or evaluate another grammar.
decisionRules.futility: No candidate passes every frozen gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the complete one-bit producer-to-next-Attack setup grammar without implementation. Continue with the next materially different source- and evidence-backed structural family inside issue #421; do not subset producer cards, change persistence, weaken support, alter the payoff or add another candidate to this inventory.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The immutable trace, source identity or deterministic inventory cannot produce a complete decision before the numeric wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, trace extension or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source-card construction, trace validation, sequence detection, policy classification, selection and stop/go. Existing exact traces are immutable input. No model context, human label, ML, RL, optimiser or adaptive candidate-by-candidate simulation enters the decision.
